ImageDescription.value:
قدیمی‌ترین محله‌ی تهران، شمالی‌ترین نقطه‌ی خیابان طولانی ولیعصر، تجریش باصفا، با بازار قدیمی خوش آب و رنگ خود، 
سال‌هاست که نه تنها مقصد تهران‌گردی گردشگرانی از کشورهای مختلف جهان است، بلکه گاهی مقصدی برای گذراندن یک آخر هفته‌ی مهیج برای تهران‌نشینان نیز می‌باشد. نام تهران تا همیشه با تجریش قدیمی با کوچه‌پس‌کوچه‌های پیچ در پیچ و دیوارهای آجری و خشتی خانه‌های قدیمی‌اش درهم تنیده شده است.

I hope you enjoy my videos, to support the channel, please subscribe and ring the bell to be informed of new videos, and to improve the videos, please leave a comment.

I can close my eyes and imagine myself in the colorful Tajrish Bazaar, feeling the aroma of fresh foods and spices and hearing the sellers and buyers bargaining; Such an incredible feel in a traditional Persian bazaar. Tajrish Bazaar is located in the heart of Tajrish historical neighborhood and near Imamzadeh Saleh (AS). It is not only a place for trades but also a cultural and social center; A combination of bazaars, mosques, shrines, prayer rooms, and restaurants in one neighborhood. Actually, I like its indoor fruit and vegetable section most. I think it is a smaller example of the Tehran Grand Bazaar. In the Tajrish market, all kinds of goods, including fresh foods, nuts, Iranian saffron, spices, pickles, handicrafts including kilim, Khatam, Mina, copper, pottery, etc., are sold. On the other hand, several modern malls such as Ghaem and Tandis shopping centers are near Tajrish Bazaar, where you can continue your sightseeing and shopping in Tehran. Also, Darband Recreational Site and Saad Abad Palace are located near Tajrish Bazaar.
